articleBody:
- [ ] Source leak identification confirmed — ensures work only starts after the active plumbing leak, grout gap, or roof leak is stopped.
- [ ] Substrate drying procedure detailed — verifies that wet studs and cavities dry within 24 to 48 hours before being sealed up.
- [ ] Removal boundaries specified — defines whether the crew is cutting back to sound framing or only scraping superficial paper.
- [ ] Moisture-resistant board specified — guarantees green board or cement backer is installed instead of standard porous gypsum in damp zones.
- [ ] Fastener and spacing standards noted — ensures proper framing attachment so panels do not bow or crack under humidity.
- [ ] Embedded tape joint finishing included — prevents cracked seams by using correct tape embedment rather than quick-fill spackle.
- [ ] Primer coat itemized — confirms repaired drywall will be sealed against bathroom humidity prior to paint application.
- [ ] Dust control and cleanup plan — clarifies how the work area will be isolated from the rest of your home during sanding.

How to use this checklist:
Run through these items when comparing bids for drywall work. If a quote skips structural drying or doesn't name the materials going on your walls, ask for clarification before moving forward.
